state.document: An umpire's account of a clash about to be decided.
state.situation: Zieten's hussars, fresh and in good order, come out of the oak wood and charge the right flank of the Austrian line on the Křečhoř heights. The Austrian battalions there stand in line facing west, already shaken by musketry, and did not see the hussars until they left the wood. No Austrian cavalry is near.

poor: the attacker is at a clear disadvantage
even: neither side has a clear advantage
favourable: the attacker has a clear advantage
decisive: the attacker holds every advantage; the defender cannot withstand it
